svg.title: Write ai > 0 for the lattice spacing at scale i, and Li = ai/ai+1 for its integer block ratio. The construction chooses odd ratios at least three. The scale time is ti = log(a−1 i ), so ti+1 −ti = log Li. Block ratios can be increased stage by stage; subsequent lower bounds on the reference coupling are called delays.
